name: Data Engineering
tagline: Build the pipelines and platforms that move, clean and serve data for analytics and AI.

overview.summary: Data engineers build the 'plumbing' for data: pipelines that collect data from apps, databases and APIs, clean and transform it, and load it into warehouses or lakehouses where analysts and AI systems can use it. They care about reliability (pipelines that don't break at 3 a.m.), data quality, cost and speed. Every AI project depends on good data, which is why data engineering demand has grown alongside AI.
whyTrending: AI and LLM projects need clean, well-governed data — retrieval systems, feature stores and training sets all rely on data pipelines.
The WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025 ranks big data specialists as the fastest-growing job in percentage terms.
Open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) are replacing older Hadoop stacks, creating demand for engineers who know the modern tools.
BLS projects database architects — the closest US category to senior data engineers — to grow faster than average (9%, 2025–35).

roles.title: Big Data / Platform Engineer
roles.description: Runs Spark, Kafka and lakehouse infrastructure and makes it reliable and cost-efficient.

roles.title: Streaming Data Engineer
roles.description: Builds real-time pipelines with Kafka, Flink or Spark Structured Streaming for fraud, IoT or live dashboards.

roles.title: AI Data Engineer

stack.note: SQL + Python + one cloud platform + Airflow/dbt covers most junior and mid-level listings. Spark and Kafka appear in larger-scale roles.

interview.question: ETL vs ELT?
interview.answer: ETL transforms data before loading into the warehouse; ELT loads raw data first and transforms inside the warehouse. ELT is common today because cloud warehouses are powerful and keep raw data for reprocessing.

interview.question: What is a star schema?
interview.answer: A data model with a central fact table (events/measurements) linked to dimension tables (who, what, where, when), designed for fast, simple analytical queries.

interview.question: What makes a pipeline idempotent and why does it matter?
interview.answer: Running it multiple times produces the same result (e.g. using upserts or overwriting partitions). It makes retries and backfills safe.

interview.question: Batch vs streaming processing?
interview.answer: Batch processes data in chunks on a schedule (simpler, cheaper). Streaming processes events continuously with low latency (fraud detection, live metrics) but is more complex.

interview.question: Why use Parquet instead of CSV?
interview.answer: Parquet is columnar, compressed and typed, so analytical queries read only needed columns and run much faster and cheaper.

interview.question: What is partitioning?
interview.answer: Splitting a table by a key such as date so queries scan only relevant partitions, reducing cost and time.

interview.question: How do you ensure data quality?
interview.answer: Add tests for nulls, uniqueness, ranges and referential integrity (dbt tests, Great Expectations), monitor freshness and volume, and alert on failures.

interview.question: What is a slowly changing dimension (SCD Type 2)?
interview.answer: A way to keep history of dimension changes by adding a new row with valid-from/valid-to dates instead of overwriting the old value.

interview.question: What does Airflow do?
interview.answer: It schedules and orchestrates workflows defined as DAGs of tasks, handling dependencies, retries, backfills and monitoring.

interview.question: How would you handle late-arriving data in streaming?
interview.answer: Use event-time processing with watermarks that define how long to wait for late events, and design downstream tables to accept corrections.

remote.note: Estimate. Arc reports $41,569 average for Bangladesh-based remote back-end developers and $69,548 for seniors; cloud data platform skills command a premium.

global.note: BLS has no 'data engineer' title; database architects are the closest match for senior data engineers. Database administrators earn a lower $104,620 median with flat growth.

demandNotes.bangladesh: High at telecoms, banks, MFS and offshore software firms building data platforms for foreign clients. Postings often ask for SQL, Python and Spark or a cloud warehouse.
demandNotes.remote: High. Many remote contracts are pipeline builds or warehouse migrations — well suited to freelancers with a strong portfolio.
demandNotes.global: Very high. Data engineering underpins every AI initiative and is consistently among the most-posted data roles.
